title: Reconciliation Through Christ
definition: Reconciliation through Christ is the restoration of peace between God and sinners through the death of Jesus.
summary: Christ reconciles enemies to God through the cross.
christFocus: Jesus makes peace by His blood and brings sinners near to God.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Sin makes people enemies of God, alienated from Him and unable to restore themselves. Reconciliation is God's gracious work of bringing sinners back into peace through Christ.

The cross is the means of reconciliation. Jesus bears sin, removes hostility, and brings believers near to God.

Those reconciled to God are entrusted with the message of reconciliation and called to pursue peace with others.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many people think their main need is self-improvement, not peace with God. Reconciliation matters because the greatest relationship broken by sin is restored only through Christ.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive peace with God through Christ. Then live as a reconciled person, pursuing forgiveness, peace, and Gospel witness.
